# Ride N Care

> Care in Every Mile — doorstep bike service and bike repair in Bangalore, Karnataka, India.

Ride N Care is a doorstep two-wheeler service and repair provider in Bangalore, Karnataka, India. Certified mechanics travel to the customer's home or office to service motorcycles, scooters and electric two-wheelers using OEM-grade parts, with the price agreed in writing before work starts. Car service is also offered.

- Business name: Ride N Care
- Tagline: Care in Every Mile
- Website: https://ridencare.co.in
- Phone: 08296950339 / 08069409289 (WhatsApp: +91 82969 50339)
- Email: ridencareinfo@gmail.com
- Location: Bangalore, Karnataka, India
- Hours: 8:00 AM – 9:00 PM, all seven days
- Payments: UPI, cards, net banking, cash. Digital invoice after every job.
- Guarantee: 7-day workmanship guarantee on work performed.

## What Ride N Care does

Bike service Bangalore · Bike repair Bangalore · Doorstep bike service Bangalore · Two wheeler service Bangalore · Motorcycle repair Bangalore · Scooter repair Bangalore · Emergency bike repair and breakdown assistance.

## Key answers

- Does Ride N Care provide doorstep bike service? Yes — a mechanic comes to your address; a periodic service usually takes 60–90 minutes.
- How do I book? Call or WhatsApp 08296950339 / 08069409289, or use the booking form at /contact. A written quote is shared before the visit.
- How fast is a visit? Slots booked before 4:00 PM are usually served the same day; emergency calls are attended within hours in core areas.
- What does a service include? Engine oil, oil and air filter, spark plug, brakes, chain, clutch and throttle play, battery check, tyres, lights, wash and a 25-point inspection report.
- Price? Jump Start is ₹399, Running Repair is ₹450, and General Service starts at ₹799 for bikes up to 199cc; parts are quoted separately.

## Service areas in Bangalore

HSR Layout, Koramangala, Indiranagar, Domlur, Ejipura, BTM Layout, Madiwala, Bommanahalli, Kudlu Gate, Singasandra, Parappana Agrahara, Electronic City, Marathahalli, Bellandur, HAL, Mahadevapura, KR Puram, Whitefield, Brookefield, Varthur, Gunjur, Harlur, Sarjapur Road, Kasavanahalli, Choodasandra, Panathur Road, Kadubeesanahalli, Banashankari, Jayanagar, JP Nagar and nearby localities.
